After only

Collapsed before was captured on Items and after on Settings, so that pair is not claimed as matched. Phone-width web stayed CSS/source smoke; the Cursor browser viewport remained desktop.

What changed, and why

Destinations are grouped by job

Was

Dashboard through Settings sat in one unlabeled list, then Operations. Notifications duplicated the top-bar bell.

Now

Daily work is first. Team, Library, and Operations are labeled groups. Settings is a global destination. Notifications are top-bar only.

Account owns identity actions

Was

Avatar and name sat above the nav. Theme, Help, and Log out filled the footer as separate controls.

Now

A compact Badgers lockup leads. The footer identity opens Profile, Help, theme, and Log out. Collaborators also reach Settings.

The top bar is a command strip

Was

A short Search… field, a heavy Preview as outline, and a generic Toggle Sidebar name.

Now

Search names tags, people, and pages, carries a ⌘K chip, and grows. Preview is ghost. The trigger says Collapse/Expand sidebar or Open/Close navigation.

Active and collapsed states are quieter

Was

A red left rail on every active item, and collapsed badges hanging into the page.

Now

Active is a filled pill. Collapsed rail is 3.5rem with badges on the icon. Red stays on overdue/unread counts.

Verification

  • Focused vitest: tests/web-sidebar-source.test.ts, tests/shell-navigation.test.ts, tests/app-shell-search-source.test.ts passed.
  • npx tsc --noEmit passed.
  • Authenticated Chromium: expanded Settings chrome, account menu (Profile/Help/theme/Log out), command palette from the top-bar search (query FX3), collapse/expand labels, Bookings overdue badge, Notifications unread on the bell.
  • npm run build:app was not run; the local preview server owns .next.

Things to know

  • Phone-width web is CSS/source smoke (max-md search icon, bottom nav, 11px labels). The Cursor browser viewport stayed desktop.
  • Light appearance was not recaptured. The sidebar remains Wisconsin dark in both themes.
  • Schedule sticky pinning still measures [data-app-shell-header]; header height stayed h-12.
  • Unrelated dirty page-chrome and schedule work was left untouched.
